strings.en: Hee hee...
Ugh... Y-You're...
Amuro.
Lalah Sune...!
...He's... coming... Hee hee.
Don't think you can claim Char and me both as your own!
Living forever as pure thought would be torture... I just want to watch you.
That's just ego!
I want to stay between you two forever...
Reject Char, then!
...He's pure...
Pure...!?
...A dream.
(Damn... I've started having the same dream again... Why?)
...Merely dropping Axis on Earth
will cause damage on the scale of a nuclear winter.
It's an atrocity no dictator has ever committed.
...Are you sure about this? Colonel Char.
It's too late for sermons, Nanai.
I believe in the evolution of humanity that has gone out into space...
But to turn all of humanity into Newtypes...
someone has to bear that sin.
Has the last war... weighed on you that much?
The Land of Beginning... It binds people, keeping them from evolving...
And that's why you intend to see it through alone, Colonel?
I'm not that much of a narcissist, Nanai.
...But as things are, we'll give rise to a second, a third Einst...
...I'm counting on you for this operation.
I'll go ahead to Axis and wait for you there.
Yes, sir. And Quess... is that all right...?
I don't think she needs any more enhancement than that...?
No. Even without a psycoframe, that girl...
is a Newtype who can control funnels.
I'd imagine so... She'll have to carry the next generation.
Captain Bright!
Thanks for coming, Kamille. Sorry about this.
...Is it true?
That Quattro... no, Char Aznable... is dropping an asteroid!?
...Yes.
Damn it, how did we miss that Char was preparing an army...!?
The Earth Federation rules space from Earth.
There are tons of Spacenoids who hate that...
If Londo Bell goes to investigate, ordinary people cover for him.
The last war... and now this, right after it...
Had he been planning this... all along? ...Captain Quattro?
Probably.
...I should have paid more attention to his moves at Anaheim.
Nina, you didn't notice anything?
...I'm sorry.
I don't keep track of every department.
...What now, Bright?
With our current forces... no, with the Federation space forces,
we can't stop it... I've contacted Commander Hazuki on Earth.
Then...!
...We'll be forming Londo Bell again, like back then.
It seems Judau and the others are heading here too.
I've called her in, too.
...Are you sure? Your wife may be enlisted,
but isn't she off regular duty?
She's been slacking a bit too much lately.
Besides, this is hardly regular duty... I'm sending Excellen out too.
...Like back then... though I suppose
we won't have the Dangaioh team or Rom and the others...
It can't be helped. ...Bright, what's the plan for the rendezvous?
It's taken care of. ...Now it's a matter... of time.
Is everyone here?
Just the Mazinger team left...
Banjo, was it really Captain Quattro?
I can't believe it.
Me neither...
But it's also certain that his asteroid is drawing closer.
So all that pent-up stuff finally blew, huh?
When you think about it,
trying to manage peace in space from the ground really is impossible.
Manage? Do people on the ground even have the right
to manage the people in space in the first place?
I don't get it all, but...
what the Captain's trying to do is wrong, isn't it?
Tch! What did we risk our lives protecting Earth for!?
Kappei's right, but...
Captain Quattro fought alongside us in that war.
That's the part I don't get.
Isn't Captain Quattro supposed to be Zeon's last legacy or something?
Maybe he's just being used as a figurehead?
No, I can definitely sense his strong will...
That another one of them oracles from Mu?
It's not an oracle... It's just how it feels to me.
Knowing his personality... he's not doing it 'cause someone told him to.
Sorry! Kept you waiting!
You're late, Koji!!
Sorry, Cham. My brother took forever getting ready.
I'm sorry... Grendizer has been acting up...
It seems the god of Fleed is torn over this battle.
Oh, everyone's here? We've been waiting.
Hm? Is this everyone? Are the Gundam Fighters
with the Nadesico crew?
Yeah, we couldn't reach the King of Hearts...
He's probably off training somewhere, anyway.
The Nadesico folks have all gone back to their normal lives...
Well, we can't force civilians into this.
Hey now, we're civilians too, ya know?
If you put it that way, so are we.
Right now, whoever can act just has to do their best...
No, even so... this is quite a stellar lineup.
Well then, let's get going. Quattro... don't do anything rash!
